question: What would make local token 110 and Parpola sign no. 41 an admissible crosswalk rather than a visual hunch?
result: The immediate admissibility test is panel identity, not visual similarity: H-2148's clean single-panel source image must be explicitly tied to both local token 110 and Parpola sign no. 41 on the same physical side. Until then the crosswalk remains P0.
admissible_only_if: H-2148 source image clearly shows the clean single-panel target
the same physical side/panel is explicitly mapped to local 110
Parpola sign no. 41 is demonstrably assigned to that same physical side/panel
the graphic form is stable under source-quality inspection
at least one outside control or independent branch witness supports the same relation
H-940 is either excluded or re-enters only after source-grade topology match
kill_if: H-2148 clean panel maps to a local row other than 110
Parpola sign no. 41 refers to the companion side
source-grade H-2148 evidence shows damage, hatching, or multi-sign clustering
outside controls map the same graphic form to a different local token
H-940 remains graphically different while still belonging to Parpola no. 41
local 110 splits into multiple source-visible graphic classes with no allographic rule
